scope: All 1,352 entrypoints screened by path/description and scoped text search; selected complete reads. Mirrors and translations are not independent capabilities, and not every variant was compared semantically.

repositories.decision: Derive learner adaptation from pstack/teach and learning sequence/retrospective from the teaching plugin. Reject fixed pauses, mandatory diagrams, and blanket quiz prohibition.
Derive goal-linked practice, feedback, and evidence of progress. Reject mandatory persistent course workspaces, HTML, and equal-length quiz answers.
Adapt show-me: choose the smallest representation that answers the learning question. No fixed host invocation or open command.
Adapt eli5: choose a useful medium, reframe failed explanations, and inspect rendered controls. No mandatory media stack.
interview-me offers focused questions, but decision interviews are not learning assessments. No additional donor adopted.
Adapt ce-explain intake and application checks, including answer guidance. Support live teaching instead of its static-only check-ins.
academy-guide supports intent-led resource choice; doc-coauthoring stays with the documentation owner. discernment-nudge excludes purely educational explanations. No additional donor adopted.
writing-guidelines links external writing instructions. Useful writing guidance already has a local owner; no teaching donor adopted.
code-tour and codebase-onboarding illustrate source-grounded tours; manim-video/ui-demo show purposeful scenes. Do not impose their output stacks or agent-learning memory loops.
brainstorming concerns design decisions; do not impose its approval workflow on lessons.
grill-me and write-docs concern decision interviews and documentation; existing owners cover these mechanisms.

assessments.name: teach
assessments.author: Lauren Tan / pstack
assessments.summary: Start from the learner purpose and prior knowledge; explain a concrete mechanism at appropriate depth. Preserve historical confidence and combine evidence into the explanation itself.
assessments.reason: Start from the learner purpose and prior knowledge; explain a concrete mechanism at appropriate depth. Preserve historical confidence and combine evidence into the explanation itself.
assessments.caution: Use local explain-code and explain-decisions conditionally, with direct evidence fallback. No fixed sentence stops, mandatory repeated diagrams, image generation, English-only conversation, or upstream runtime dependencies.
assessments.inspection: Complete entrypoint and listed instructional references read; selected adaptation only.

assessments.name: teach
assessments.author: Matt Pocock
assessments.summary: Tie a bounded lesson to a meaningful goal; combine knowledge with appropriate practice and feedback. Distinguish presented material from evidence of understanding; adapt subsequent practice.
assessments.reason: Tie a bounded lesson to a meaningful goal; combine knowledge with appropriate practice and feedback. Distinguish presented material from evidence of understanding; adapt subsequent practice.
assessments.caution: One-session teaching is supported; no automatic course workspace, HTML, profile, glossary, or records. No fixed answer length in quizzes, mandatory communities, or claim that a record computes a psychological development zone.
assessments.inspection: Complete entrypoint and listed instructional references read; selected adaptation only.

localDecisions: Two independently usable skills: teach and learning-plan.
Business grounding, learner separation, graduated hints, and full-course completion follow the user contract; they are not claimed as validated donor efficacy.
No automatic profiles, records, installs, publishing, or calendars.
explain-code and explain-decisions preserve evidence boundaries with clearer names.
